description: The runner's own control (`tools/runner-control.mjs`), played apart from the cases. `repository-missing` is refused by `metadata` under `--release`, warned of in an ordinary run and refused under `--rehearsal`, as it declares (`releaseOnly`, `rehearsal: "blocks"`), and the runner has to report nothing of it as written. It has to report each variant, every one a rule no prepared case can prove, since every case is built to be refused as it declares: over `_reference` without its two modes, a case that passed; without its modes and with `check` set to `licence`, or `rule` set to `dead`, another check or rule; without `releaseOnly`, a `rehearsal` nothing reads; without `rehearsal`, or with it set to `often`, a case with two modes that does not say what the third reading does; with it set to `warns`, a rehearsal that blocks; over `since-next` as `since` at point 10, a rehearsal that passes where the case says it blocks; and with `drop` set to `["LICENSE"]`, an ordinary run that blocks beside its warning.
